immutability: The corpus SHA-256 is copied verbatim into the frozen release contract. Any post-freeze mismatch fails the evaluation-integrity gate.

inherited_validator_compatibility.observed_defect: A v0.03 manifest hash over shared append-only ledgers fails after legitimate v0.04 appends.
required_evidence: Unchanged historical prefix plus later appended JSONL records passes historical manifest verification.
Mutation inside the historical prefix fails.
Version-local immutable file mutation still fails.

metrics.clean_case_acceptance_rate: clean cases with zero findings / clean cases
metrics.defect_case_detection_rate: defect cases with all expected rules and no missing expected rule / defect cases
metrics.diagnostic_completeness_rate: findings with nonempty rationale and exact source span / all findings

supported_profile: Deterministic Markdown lint profile: requirement/task/component headings plus field markers, with contextual prose rules outside fenced code, blockquotes, Notes:, and Rationale: lines.
suppression_governance: A suppression directive may only suppress a rule when it names an approved DEC-* identifier supplied to the linter.
Unknown/unapproved suppression decisions must not hide findings and must emit a suppression-governance diagnostic.
Suppressions are explicit and local; blanket disable-all is unsupported in v0.04.
target_policy: All seeded synthetic metrics target 1.0 because the corpus is deterministic and preregistered. Real-project effectiveness remains unvalidated and caps v0.04 at experimental promotion.
